nom: COSRX Advanced Snail Mucin Gel Cleanser

avis.texte: Hello thanks Ulta for always having the best products and providing the opportunity to try things and returning if they are not the best product for us. Yes I do like Advanced Snail Mucin Gel Cleanser I should also get any toner to go along with the cleanser. Makes my face look and feel clean. Nice

I was disappointed with this face wash. Despite its claims, I did not notice any moisturizing benefits, and my skin felt dry and tight after washing. The texture also felt unusual during application, which made the experience less pleasant. I've used many face washes over the years, but this is one of the few that left me feeling as though it didn't effectively cleanse or care for my skin. Unfortunately, this product did not meet my expectations.

I bought this cleanser 16 months ago, have used it 2x/day nearly every day and I still have some in the bottle. I only have to use a pea sized amount and I get a good foam and my face feels clean and so so soft and hydrated. I could not more highly recommend it for both quality and value.

I've been using this about two and a half weeks and I think I like it. I don't have any issues as far as it making my skin feel right and dry like some cleansers have. It's Koran skincare, what more could you ask for?
I will repurchase this over and over again. I love how gentle and hydrating it is while also doing it's job as a cleanser.

avis.titre: A little goes a LONG way
avis.texte: I use the COSRX Snail Mucin Cleanser, Power Essence Serum, Eye Cream, and All In One Cream, combined with a Mario Badescu toner and a multitude of The Ordinary treatments to form a personalized and highly effective skin care regimen that has made my skin look and feel tighter, firmer, healthier, and younger. On days when I'm in a rush, the Snail Mucin line is my go-to and is effective on its own, but combined with a few Ordinary products, it's the most amazing skin care regimen I have ever used. This is the best cleanser I have used since the Arbonne RE9 line which is very expensive and difficult to find. I was very skeptical at first, but I've been thrilled with this cleanser, and it only takes a tiny bit and lasts forever.
Wasnt for me. I developed at least ten zits after three days of use
I was so excited to used this product unfortunately it messed my skin barrier real bad

avis.titre: This is my all time favorite cleanser
avis.texte: I recently switched to this cleanser not long ago. At the time I was using a different snail mucin cleanser. It was soothing, sure, but didn't have enough cleansing power. I needed something more potent. Then I got the mini version of this for christmas. I loved it, my skin cleared up. I use this after the micellar water from the same brand and it works wonders without stripping the skin.
I love this cleanser. It feels good on my face and gives me a natural glow.

I got a mini one of these in a free sample bag. I ended up buying a full size one. it foams up nicely which I think is a big deal lol. I don't trust cleansers that don't get foamy. it does has a very strong earthy smell to it, but I'm not bothered by fragrances. it does the job. skin feels smooth and clean after.

I received a sample of this with another purchase. I love the smell. It is pretty concentrated which I also like and my skin felt really good after using it and not dry. I also believe it did a good job of cleaning my skin.

avis.titre: COSRX Advanced Snail Mucin Gel Cleanser
avis.texte: The COSRX Advanced Snail Mucin Gel Cleanser is amazing! It leaves my skin feeling clean, hydrated, and super soft without stripping it. The gentle formula works perfectly for my sensitive skin, and the snail mucin adds a nice boost of hydration and glow. It's a great addition to any skincare routine. Highly recommend!

I love all of the Cosrx snail mucin products and bought this without reading any reviews or researching. I've been using Missha super aqua cell renew snail cleanser for years and it's my favorite affordable hydrating cleanser. I won't be returning the Cosrx, but I doubt I will repurchase, solely because it smells like cheap dish soap to me and is unpleasant to use. It works fine, leaves my skin feeling hydrating and clean, but the smell is just off-putting for me and cheapens it. Pros: texture, hydration, lather, and no allergic reaction. Cons: price and smell

avis.titre: If you have gentle skin this is perfect!!
avis.texte: Im always skeptical buying cleansers but I love their snail 92 gel for a moisturizer and i absolutely love this cleanser. It doesnt burn my face or dry it out like every other cleanser ive used. It doesnt have a smell. Its an amazing price for what you get because I only use a pea sized amount (they always say to use a pea sized amount but this time its fr)

I received this in a sample box and loved it. If you can get past the snail mucin part, it is a very gel like product and smooths on your skin which makes it feel moisturizing as it dissolves your makeup. It also has a pleasing odor. The price point is also great for how much product you get and it takes very little to take off your makeup (and I wear a lot of product).

When I first started using this product it broke me out. I thought about stopping use but kept using the product holding onto hope that i'm breaking out because its just really getting in them pores. Yup. I've been using this product as the second step of my double cleans twice a day and ya'll my skin is so clear. I use other products too so i'm not giving this product all the credit to my results but it's now a staple product because it cleans VERY good but is so gentle on the skin. And the scent is a light refreshing citrus!

avis.titre: HG status for dry sensitive skin
avis.texte: Everyone talks about the essence but this is my favorite from the snail line. This is the only non-cream based cleanser that works for me. I'm in my 40s and my skin very prone to dryness and redness. this cleanser doesn't strip it, the way the cosrx low pH one did, and doesn't irritate my face. It still leaves my face feeling clean, which isn't always the case with the mold lotion like cleansers.
I've only used this twice but I really like it. It is very light and leaves my skin so smooth and clear. When I apply it, it doesn't leave a burning sensation. I would definitely buy again.
I bought this thinking it would be very nice but upon using a few times realized how oily my skin was getting minutes after using
It does not dry out my face, and a little goes a long way. I love how soft my face feels after using this cleanser.
I really like this cleanser! It is gentle but seems to clean well.

avis.titre: It's a Yes, From Me, Dawg!
avis.texte: Love this product. So cost friendly, and a solid choice in face cleansers. This leaves my skin soft and hydrated, and if followed by the serum, i immediately have the most perfect dewy glow. No down-sides—try this cleanser!

avis.titre: I've been buying this product since 2021!
avis.texte: GLASS SKIN is what u get from using this product and using this brand.

I have dry skin with redness and texture around my jaw line. This product helped smooth out that textured area and left my skin feeling so hydrated. This cleanser in addition to other COSRX snail mucin products gave helped me have such smooth skin. Worth every penny!

So I have dry skin and this cleanser is amazing!!! It starts off as a gel and then lathers beautifully! This cleanser really hydrates and cleans my dry skin. I definitely recommend if you have dry skin!
I enjoy the clean feeling and it is not soap. You get the snail mucin benefits.
Very hydrating! A little goes a long way, it foams up really nicely and leaves my face feeling very moisturized and clean. I use it AM & PM , A bottle will last you for awhile.

I've had great luck with other cosrx products but this made my skin look so dull. It was like I didnt even cleanse my face at all and I felt like there was some kind of buildup on my skin. I used it for a few weeks and finally gave up. Switched to another brand and life came back to my face.

i dont like gel cleansers, i tried the ph good morning cleanser by cosrx and it broke me out. i immediately used this product and after two weeks the pimples from the breakout were gone! this profuct is unbelievable, my new go to cleanser!

This cleanser is way too drying for my combination skin. It gave me dry patches inbetween my eyebrows and on my cheeks, and it made my makeup separate. I typically love the cosrx snail mucin line, but the cleanser specifically I would not recommend. Only pro is that it did not make my skin breakout, so if you have very oil acne prone skin it may work for you.

Ive been using this product for years when it was in a jar. They changed the packaging and i swear they also changed the formula. Its no where near as hydrating as it was before- if anything its a little drying. It also pills like crazy now, which it never used to do and i combine it with the same products i always use. Dissapointed!!
If youre acne prone do notttt use this. This literally gave me blister acne so painful.

avis.titre: Perfect for Dry, Acne Prone Skin
avis.texte: Didnf expect to loce this as much as I did. The Cosrx Good Morning Low pH Gel Cleanser has been my go to for years now. This cleanser, like the Good Morning one, leaves my skin feeling so soft, not stripped at all. Foamy, but creamy at the same time. Would definetely recommend!

avis.titre: Will definitely buy this Face Gel Cleanser again
avis.texte: The product is so creamy. And the Sales Associate, Lizeth, told me a little product goes a long way. Excellent product!
This has a slight lemony scent and feels amazing on my dry, sensitive skin! It's low foaming and very moisturizing. I use it after oil cleansing and it leaves my face feeling smooth and moisturized.
I absolutely adore this cleanser, got it as a free gift in a sample size in a purchase I made and now I'm buying the big one, smells really good and my face felt so clean after I used it
Its not even worth trying for oily skin. I got about twice the amout of sebum production after using this.

This is my favorite facial cleanser. It is so gentle and unscented. I have extremely sensitive skin and normally feel a burning/tightness feeling after washing my face with anything but I've never experienced that with this! I love this entire line of skincare products! Lightweight moisture without feeling greasy.

I love this. I wasn't sure if I would like this but I was hopeful. it's a gel Cleanser that for me doesn't foam as much as the photo but it still has a small foam to it. there is no fragrance and the texture is kind of like a gel. I love it so far

Have used 3 times so far and i will say i really like it! Im in between combo/oily and combo/dry skin depending on the season but this cleanser does not dry out my skin at all and it also doesnt leave it feeling oily or filmy. Skin feels soft and clean after! A little goes a long way and i mean LITTLE. I do wish it foamed up a little more but it does get a good lather the more water you add.
the entire snail line from cosrx is unbeatable. this cleanser just sets the tone. love it.

avis.titre: Be careful ( gave me chemical burns)
avis.texte: I honestly never write reviews on anything but i feel like i have too. I feel bad about leaving a negative review because i love there other products, but this product literally gave me chemical burns on my face. It started with one little one and then it spred all over my face, i had no idea what was happening until i realized it was this product that was doing it to me. It honestly was a horrible experience. This may just be how my face reacted so just please be careful if you decide to get this.

This cleanser is great for normal to oil skin. I would not recommend it for dry skin. I have sensitive skin that is often dehydrated and/or dry that often reacts to products easily. This product left my skin feeling clean, supple, and did not cause any adverse reactions. Also, it only takes a pea size amount so the product last a long time. Great value for the price. Chose to switch to their hydration line as i have dehydrated skin.

avis.titre: It's better than what I used to use
avis.texte: I was skeptical about switching to a korean brand, and this one was popping up everywhere. I struggled with mainly dark spots and acne on my cheek ( especially my right cheek) and finding a good cleanser was always a hassle. I actually bought the travel size before committing to the full size and honestly I dont regret it whatsoever, in the beginning I had purging which is normal and that alone made me want to stop but I am glad that I just sucked it up and kept using it and once the travel sizes finished I bought the full size and im really loving how my skin has turned out, I use some of their other products as well and I enjoy them very much
The gel really moisturizes the skin greatly and has a thick texture. I would recommend this to anybody trying to step up their skin care
Smells very subtle but nice! Keeps skin hydrated without feeling like it's stripping my skin dry. Nice gel like consistency that "lathers" up well
Love this cleanser, and it doesn't leave my face feeling dry/stripped.
The formula feels a little weird when washing it off. It has a thick feeling that you have to wash off. It has a nice scent and leaves my skin feeling clean without drying it out.

This stuff is amazing! I've had problems with finding cleansers that work for me. It's not harsh on the skin and feels really nice. Doesn't leave my skin feeling dry or over hydrated. Recommend recommend recommend!

My skin is on the dry side and this cleanser is a great addition to my routine. I use this after the cica oil cleanser and this removes any makeup that may have been missed, and it leaves my skin feeling so moisturized and glowy.

I wanted to love this product and gave it a fair chance (3 weeks.) I felt the more and more I used this product, I noticed how incredibly dry my skin was getting… to the point where when I wore makeup, it was really noticeable & this was the only thing i changed. I did like the texture (gel) & it was okay for my acne skin but it wasnt worth having flaky dry skin.
First time use of this product. In just a week I can see and feel a difference in my skin. I love that such a little bit goes a long way.
One of my favorite cleansers and the smell is so amazing I absolutely love it
Absolute favorite face cleanser! The smell is so fresh and clean!
I just got this product, but so far I'm liking it a lot! Feels good on the face and doesn't strip away moisture after washing my face. It gets off most of my makeup too!
So this is my second time buying it and I absolutely love it!!! I highly recommend it to new people and especially for people who have sensitve skin. I feel like it doesnt irritate it.
One of my favorite cleanser ever! Very moisturizing, my skin feels great after use ing!
This is literally the best face wash ever. It doesn't leave your face feeling dry and tight like other face washes do.
A little goes a long way. Love this cleanser. It makes my face feel so clean and hydrated. Doesn't dry me out at all. I just started using Cosrx and love everything!
This cleanser is soooo good cleans very well without stripping my skin

so I have psoriasis. about two years ago I had a cancer scare and stress of it caused a flare up on my face. despite trying so many products, it just kept getting worse until I couldn't wear foundation anymore because it would look like my face was peeling right between my eyebrows. the foundation just stuck to those areas so bad. I saw a review for this line from someone who's bf had psoriasis and how it helped so I immediately bought the line and I'm so glad! I exfoliate maybe once a week with a peel, then use this every single day. as long as I keep up on using the line, I can actually wear foundation again! also, FYI, snails are a member of the mollusk family so if you're allergic to clams or oysters, don't use it. I am, but I was willing to risk the allergic reaction. thankfully my allergy isn't that severe that I can use it topically and be okay.
This cleanser gets my skin squeaky clean without stripping it. Nice lather and lightly scented. Also, doesn't irritate my eyes. My new favorite!
I love that this cleanser lathers well and cleans my face without stripping my skin. Most gel cleansers make my face feel tight and dry after cleansing, but this one doesn't.
All time favorite cleanser. It has a slight citrus smell which I love! Great for sensitive skin

Amazing cleanser I thought it would be too slick to actually remove my makeup but since I double cleanse regardless it does just fine with removing my makeup but doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or dry after I'm done washing my face

avis.titre: Another great product from this line
avis.texte: Love the texture, the smell and the sensation on the skin once cleansed. I trust the snail mucin line of cosarx to protect my face

First thing I wanna say is consistency is the key. It's a really good size. A little goes a long way. Leave your skin smooth. I was really scared to use this on my face because I have oily sensitive skin. But it's really good. I see the change and I love it.
This cleanser leaves me feeling clean but not over dry. This is a much needed addition to my skin care regimen.
Texture is good! Very light-weight! Yet to see the miraculous skin improvement but definitely like using this.
Great for acne scars and even skin tone and face and neck Great hydration and glass finish for your daily skin care

This is my go-to cleanser. It works well, my skin feels soft after using. It doesn't cause skin irritation. It's extremely soothing. The price point is great and it lasts a long time. I don't use any other cleanser.
Best cleanser i have ever used, my second purchase. So good, your skin will thank you after use

This has helped my face so much! It has the perfect consistency, it's great for my dry and sensitive skin! A small amount goes a long way, this cleanser lathers so nicely so I can cover my face with a smaller than pea amount!

Before buying the product I saw a review stating the person had seen results after three days of use, they weren't lying! I've used this cleanser for a week now (with a breakout on my chin) and this product will be a must in my daily routine. It smells like cleaning products, BUT it works! No burning or irritation for me ( I have sensitive skin). I've tried plenty of products and I will stick bedside this one!
Love the consistency you don't have to do much and my face feels clean after
Super hydrating. This is my third purchase, and it has become a staple in my skincare routine. My face does not feel tight after use.
skin feels nice and doesn't strip. lathers very well and the snail mucin makes my skin glow !

I have been using this everyday since i got it. It is a great gentle cleanser. It didn't magically clear my acne, but it did help to calm my skin and repair my skin barrier which in turn did help to clear my skin up about 70 % . It leaves my skin really soft and clean without feeling stripped. It has no scent in my opinion. I use the rest of the snail mucin line as well so this pairs really well with my routine.
This is very cleansing without drying out my face. My skin feels smoother.
I bought this cleanser for my 13 year old daughter and her opinion this cleanser has mild formula not drying at all make her skin soft and radiant

A little goes a long way, very gentle and has a substantial lather but leaves the skin clean and hydrated, my only complaint is the fragrance can be a bit overwhelming but I am sensitive to fragrance so that might just be me

Light and lovely! The smells is faint and I prefer that over smelly products. The snail mucin texture is like jelly and I like that it's light and you need very little of it so it'll last me a while. Great addition to my skincare it's already clearing up my skin
Love this line. Cleanser is so gentle and leave my skin so smooth, only need pea size
Great cleansing without stripping the skin or irritating the eyes.
I love how gentle it is on my face yet effectively cleans the dirt buildup. I love that it doesn't have strong perfume smell. It's definitely a must to your skincare routine.

This cleanser is very good, a small amount goes a long way. Not too foamy but not too light either. It gives the right amount of foam for less than a pea size cream. Leaves the skin fresh and nourished.

What's really nice about this cleanser is that I only need to use a pea-sized amount, and it gets my entire face--there is so much of it, so it can last a long time. It also leaves your face feeling super soft. It's great for healing your skin barrier--I'd suggest this for anyone with sensitive, irritated skin.
Holy grail, not stripping, silky texture, clear look, no smell.

love this cleanser! the slimy snail consistency is something to get used to but the product really works in cleansing your face without stripping your skin. the bottle has a good amount and has lasted me a while! love this cleanser and the whole snail mucin line!
The texture was amazing, it didn't dry out my skin. This cleanser is great.

First of all , this concoction saved my skin ! Between the way it balanced my hydration in much needed areas and deeply cleans without harsh scrubbing … it doesnt leave a residuey feel ! I literally stopped using my clinique for this !

Cleansing once a day with this has changed the game entirely. I was skeptical about snail mucin at first, it looked odd, but was so smooth on my skin. It has definitely helped clean out my pores and make my skin feel fresh everyday.
I absolutely love the great foamy feeling of the cleanser. My face feels clean and fresh after washing with the cleanser.
This has been really soothing for my face. It lightweight but gives the moisture needed. My skin has been baby soft since using. Would definitely repurchase!
New favorite cleanser. Feels gentle and not stripping, yet also makes my skin feel actually cleansed!

If you have any type of hyperpigmentation, dry patches, dull skin, just feel like your skin isn't SKINING anymore?! THEN TRY THIS! i promise i used it the first day I bought it & noticed a difference within 2-4 days! I love it! Please buy it!

I have eczema, so that means I have very dry and sensitive skin. It took me a while to find the perfect cleanser. When I started using the Snail Mucin Gel Cleanser, it felt like magic! It left my skin feeling clean and moisturized. My skin didn't even get red or irritated while using it. I give this cleanser a 10/10 for people who have eczema or sensitive skin!

I've used several different face cleansers over the years, and the Advanced Snail Mucin is just awesome! Too many times the cleanser leaves my skin feeling dry or not clean. The Advanced Snail Mucin Gel Cleanser leaves my face hydrated and clean.

LOOOVEEEE this cleanser! Super effective, great texture and consistency! Very glad of how my skin feel hydrating after every use. Just a little bit to use, no harsh and my skin feels great! Definitely recommend if you suffer from acne and sensitive skin.
My favorite face cleaner ever. Face feels clean and soft after using and it does not feel dry.

I've been struggling with dry dehydrated skin for a long time and this stuff really helped. The fragrance didnt bother me like most reviews commented on. The only con is that it doesnt help with acne, which is fine because the upside to that is my skin is soooo soft.

I have yet to find another cleanser I like as much as this one! I usually don't like scented skincare products, but this cleanser is the exception. It has such a nice, refreshing scent and it has never irritated my skin. It cleanses my skin thoroughly without drying it out. Love love love this cleanser!
